name: A Rogue's Deal
summary: A seemingly casual favor for Calvin Montague in Deathknell sends a traveler on the road to the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. The errand involves ferrying a mysterious, unaddressed message to Innkeeper Renee under the guise of an ordinary courier run.

sections.title: A Friendly Courier
sections.body: Lounging amidst the solemn graves and ruined chapels of Deathknell, Calvin Montague presents himself as an exhausted fighter burdened by too many Scourge zombies and creeping spiders. Claiming he simply needs a hand delivering a message to Brill, he entrusts passing adventurers with an unmarked letter. His breezy demeanor and promise of generous coin make the task appear as nothing more than a harmless favor meant to point freshly awakened Forsaken toward the region's main town.

sections.title: The Gallows' End Tavern
sections.body: The road leads eastward through the blighted trees of Tirisfal Glades, passing Cold Hearth Manor to reach the settlement of Brill. Behind the counter of the local tavern, Innkeeper Renee initially greets newcomers with an unnervingly sunny disposition, doting on the comfort of her patrons. However, upon receiving Montague's correspondence, her hospitality immediately fractures. Dropping her forced pleasantries, she feigns receiving word from a beloved mother before scolding the courier for prying and demanding they buy something or leave. Returning to Calvin afterward leads to another surprise: instead of settling the promised payment peacefully, he challenges the courier to a duel.

faq.answer: Calvin Montague is a rogue in Deathknell who asks newly awakened travelers to carry a letter to Innkeeper Renee in Brill. He presents it as a simple favor and promises to pay well.

faq.q: What is inside the Nondescript Letter?
faq.answer: The letter's exact contents are not recorded. Calvin gives the courier an unmarked message to deliver to Innkeeper Renee in Brill.

faq.q: Why does Innkeeper Renee act so strange?
faq.answer: Renee runs the tavern in Brill and insists that her correspondence is private. Her response to the delivery can be discovered by bringing her Montague's letter.

faq.q: Does Calvin Montague actually pay for the delivery?
faq.answer: Montague promises to pay well for the delivery. Renee offers food or water when the letter reaches her; return to Calvin afterward to continue the dealings over his promised payment.
Brill sits northeast of Deathknell. Travelers follow the main road east out of the starter valley, veer right past Cold Hearth Manor, and cross a covered bridge into the settlement.

faq.q: What happens after giving the letter to Renee?
faq.answer: The follow-up is another quest named 'A Rogue's Deal'. Return to Calvin Montague in Deathknell to continue your dealings with him.

angles.text: For recently risen Forsaken, this errand marks their very first journey away from the safety of Deathknell's graveyard toward the bustling hub of Brill.
Calvin Montague's private courier errand offers a glimpse of the informal dealings carried on around Deathknell and Brill.
The delivery leads straightforwardly to Brill, introducing newly arrived allies to the regional heart of Forsaken administration and respite in Tirisfal.
